invariant: A valid package or symbol-container opening line is one atomic ownership event, but the identity, stereotype metadata, and concrete USymbol are determined by the first registered Java command whose complete-line grammar matches. In class diagrams CommandPackage is registered before CommandPackageWithUSymbol, so a `package` line first uses CommandPackage's NAME, optional immediate `as AS`, then one trailing StereotypePattern capture. If a stereotype appears between NAME and `as`, the optional AS clause cannot match; the permissive trailing stereotype capture may instead absorb that text through the last `>>`, the Quark identity remains NAME, and StereotypeDecoration#cutLabels extracts every chevron label from the captured blob. CommandPackageWithUSymbol owns the complete keyword set `package|rectangle|hexagon|node|artifact|folder|file|frame|cloud|action|process|database|storage|component|card|queue|stack`. Its quoted-display and unquoted identity alternatives allow an identity-slot stereotype before `as`, followed by a distinct trailing STEREOTYPE capture. executeArg calls RegexResult#getLazzy rather than concatenating slots: observed Java behavior is that a populated trailing STEREOTYPE is the stored visible stereotype; otherwise the populated identity-slot capture supplies it. Once a command matches, it resolves one Quark, installs the keyword's concrete USymbol, CucaDiagram#gotoGroup creates or reuses the Entity on that Quark, and that same group becomes current scope until the matching brace. Quark.parent remains the sole ownership identity consumed by Entity#getParentContainer and SVEK cluster traversal. A malformed opener from any keyword in the complete set matches no Java command and yields a syntax error; it must never fall through to a leaf DESCRIPTION/class command or leak its children into the surrounding scope.
causal_divergence: Commit 9bcbcd11 repaired Java's ordinary-package precedence, split stereotype-slot ownership, canonical identity, and fail-closed behavior for Rust's existing shortened symbol list. The follow-up checker disproved completion at the command-family boundary. Rust SYMBOL_RE and looks_like_package_opener contain only package, namespace, cloud, database, folder, frame, rectangle, and node, while Java CommandPackageWithUSymbol contains seventeen symbols. `storage` and `artifact` therefore bypass class parsing and select DESCRIPTION; `component` and `queue` are consumed even earlier by try_entity_decl because its braced-container exclusion names only database, node, and rectangle. Valid declarations lose their package Quark, child ownership, alias, trailing-stereotype precedence, and concrete cluster symbol. The same shortened list makes malformed `node` fail closed but malformed `storage` render as a DESCRIPTION entity. PackageKind and the class renderer also lack the omitted concrete symbols, so parser widening alone would collapse their Java shapes into an unrelated package kind. The remaining divergence is one incomplete command-to-USymbol projection spanning dispatch, parser precedence, ownership data, and cluster rendering, not four fixture-specific exceptions.
planned_change: Model the complete Java CommandPackageWithUSymbol keyword set as one shared parser-owned symbol table used by subtype detection, braced-entity exclusion, SYMBOL_RE-equivalent parsing, malformed-opener detection, PackageKind construction, and renderer dispatch. Keep `namespace` as its separate Rust/Java namespace command rather than pretending it belongs to CommandPackageWithUSymbol. Extend PackageKind with the missing concrete symbols and render each from its USymbol geometry: storage rounded container, artifact folded-document mark, component tabs, queue cylindrical side, plus hexagon/file/action/process/card/stack forms according to their Java USymbol classes. Preserve ordinary `package` first refusal and existing identity/stereotype selection exactly. Any braced line beginning with a complete-set keyword must reach the package parser before leaf entity/description consumers; an invalid complete-line form returns ParseError. Keep Package.parent and transactional scope materialization unchanged. Add table-driven parser tests over every keyword, aliases, nesting, and malformed controls, plus renderer tests that assert primitive families and canonical qualified ownership on renamed perturbations. Do not map omitted symbols to visually convenient existing kinds, branch on fixture labels, or repair SVG after layout.

scope_boundary: This account supersedes both the earlier renderer-header explanation for the five missing groups and this account's own initial claim that all stereotype slots concatenate. The existing header-separation implementation remains relevant to clusters that survive parsing, but it cannot repair command selection, metadata ownership, or a discarded opener. This mechanism changes parser command semantics and ownership data only; any residual symbol header geometry after ownership is restored remains under class-package-style-header-separation.
